description: A repository-grounded security audit workflow inspired by PYA: structured static review for vulnerabilities, authorization, secrets, dependencies, infrastructure, and AI-agent risks.

defaultPrompt: Perform an evidence-based static security audit of this repository, prioritizing exploitable findings and concrete fixes.
Review changed code for security regressions and report only findings supported by repository evidence.
Audit agent, MCP, CI, dependency, and secret-handling configurations for security risks.
interface.longDescription: Guide evidence-based static security reviews of repositories, including vulnerabilities, authorization, secrets, supply-chain risks, infrastructure, and agent/MCP configuration. This is an adapted skills-only workflow and does not install or run PYA's original scanners.

name: pya-security-audit
